name: PMF.addConv_assoc
statement:
theorem addConv_assoc (f g h : PMF ℕ) :
    addConv (addConv f g) h = addConv f (addConv g h)

name: PMF.addConv_comm
statement: theorem addConv_comm (f g : PMF ℕ) : addConv f g = addConv g f

name: PMF.addConv_pure_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem addConv_pure_zero_left (f : PMF ℕ) : addConv (PMF.pure 0) f = f

name: PMF.addConv_pure_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem addConv_pure_zero_right (f : PMF ℕ) : addConv f (PMF.pure 0) = f

name: PMF.iterAddConv_add
statement:
theorem iterAddConv_add (f : PMF ℕ) (m n : ℕ) :
    iterAddConv f (m + n) = addConv (iterAddConv f m) (iterAddConv f n)

name: PMF.iterAddConv_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterAddConv_succ (f : PMF ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    iterAddConv f (n + 1) = addConv (iterAddConv f n) f

name: PMF.iterAddConv_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterAddConv_zero (f : PMF ℕ) : iterAddConv f 0 = PMF.pure 0

name: ContinuousOn.of_Icc_grid
statement:
theorem ContinuousOn.of_Icc_grid {F : Type*} [TopologicalSpace F]
    {f : α → F} {h : α} (hh : 0 < h) {a : α}
    (hf : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousOn f (Icc (a + n * h) (a + (n + 1) * h))) :
    ContinuousOn f (Ici a)

name: Nat.floor_div_eq_of_mem_Ico
locallyFinite_Icc_grid
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_Icc_grid {h : α} (hh : 0 < h) (a : α) :
    LocallyFinite fun n : ℕ => Icc (a + n * h) (a + (↑n + 1) * h)

name: mem_Ico_Nat_floor_div
statement:
theorem mem_Ico_Nat_floor_div {h : α} (hh : 0 < h) {a t : α} (hat : a ≤ t) :
    t ∈ Ico (a + ⌊(t - a) / h⌋₊ * h) (a + (↑⌊(t - a) / h⌋₊ + 1) * h)

name: piecewiseConst_eq_on_Ico
RoutingProblem.routeCost_inner_eq
statement:
theorem routeCost_inner_eq (f g : R → ℝ) :
    ∑ r, P.routeCost f r * (g r - f r)
      = ∑ ℓ, P.linkCost ℓ (P.linkFlow f ℓ) * (P.linkFlow g ℓ - P.linkFlow f ℓ)

statement:
